title: Private Tour: Capitol Hill History & Ghost Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: If you like history, and have an appreciation for ghost stories, this walking tour is the one for you. With this tour, you will get a glimpse into Denver's, Victorian past. The tour offers an expansive range of information, including: the history of the neighborhood, scandals from the past, and haunted dwellings. Fun facts about Denver, and some of its famous residents are also included in this tour. Duration: 2 hours. Walking Tour: 1.7 miles. This tour is a blast!
